items.title: Cold Cakes: is this grouping right?
items.prompt: You said to group the recipes if they are the same or very similar. I compared them: BAR-004, BAR-005 and CAK-018 are the same yeast dough (crisco, egg yolks, yeast, chill, cut like a pie; CAK-018 and BAR-004 are nearly identical). BAR-006 (Gram's Cool Cakes) is a different dough (baking powder, no yeast) with nut and apricot fillings, a double recipe, so I kept it separate. Agree?
options: Agree: group BAR-004, BAR-005 and CAK-018; keep BAR-006 separate
